VERDICT: LGTM

The new `selfLink` mapping is a trivial inline string concatenation, and that is exactly the established idiom for simple string-formatting fields in this very interface — `displayName` (line 21) inlines `owner.getLastName() + ", " + owner.getFirstName()` and `initials` (line 22) inlines char logic. The named-helper pattern (`AgeBand.of`, `OwnerIdentity.of`, `OwnerTelephone.toDisplay`, etc.) is reserved for non-trivial domain logic; a one-liner path concatenation does not warrant a dedicated helper and would look out of place as one.

The logic sits in the right unit — alongside the other derived DTO fields in `toOwnerDto` — is not duplicated, and the OpenAPI schema addition is consistent with the surrounding read-only computed fields (title/description/type/readOnly/example all present, matching the neighbors). A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
